props.name: levels
props.description: Number of density bands. Band k holds the densest (k − ½) ÷ levels share of points, counted from the core outwards.

props.name: bandwidth
props.description: Multiplier on Scott's rule bandwidth. Below 1 shows more structure, above 1 smooths it away.

props.name: gridSize
props.description: Density grid resolution per axis. Finer is smoother and slower.

props.name: showPoints
props.description: Draw the observations over the bands.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: Name of the horizontal measure, printed under the axis.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: Name of the vertical measure, printed beside the axis.

props.name: formatX
props.description: Format x values on the axis and in the tooltip.

props.name: formatY
props.description: Format y values on the axis and in the tooltip.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels. The width fills the container.
